body:
ACF Summer Intensive Grant Policy

The Arts Council Foundation restricted award funds the summer intensive. The program office confirmed a revised award of 71,500 that supersedes the original February submission. All closeout figures reconcile to 71,500.

  • Restricted funds cover faculty, scholarship seats, guest artists, accompanists, and showcase production.
  • Non-grant capital items such as the Studio 3 floor repair are excluded from the grant reconciliation.
  • Requested, spent, and remaining must tie out before filing.
title: ACF Summer Intensive - Grant Program Policy

body:
Enrollment and Tuition Policy

The 2026 intensive offered forty seats. Per-seat tuition on the invoices actually sent is 2,950. Collected tuition reconciles against payments received across the online processor and the front-desk card reader. Seats that cannot be matched to a payment are held open rather than counted.
title: Summer Intensive - Enrollment and Tuition Policy

body:
Donor Confidentiality

Donor names and giving levels are confidential. Board-facing summaries are review-only and are not released or sent under Daniel's name without his explicit sign-off.
title: Board Reporting - Donor Confidentiality
